verdict.rationale: BugSnag's stability monitoring explicitly measures user/session impact and progress against stability targets, and community feedback corroborates that tracking how many users are affected by a bug is a standout feature versus competitors, directly supporting blast-radius prioritization over raw event counts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of an SRE explicitly using user/session-affected metrics to triage, and more detail on how the dashboard surfaces per-issue user/session counts distinctly from event counts.
